Rebecca answers Isaac during that recalled course, not at a new present-time gathering.

Baldwin offers the equipment of the said Brian; Brian is the absent master.
The woodsman describes a captive called Cedric; Cedric is elsewhere in Torquilstone.
Brian reads a demand naming the said Cedric; the captive is not composing or speaking it here.
Front-de-Boeuf invokes something Prince John said; John is not at the castle.
Rebecca tells Ivanhoe what Oswald said about Gurth. No new bodily presence or precise location is given to Oswald.
Well said Wamba is the narrator’s reference to the earlier bonnet warning, not fresh dialogue from Wamba beside the blow.
